spans.s:
The affix अण् is added to the names of Meters, indicates a प्रगाथ beginning therewith.

Terms: अण्

After a word in the Nominative 1st-Case in construction, an affix comes in the sense of 'this is his dwelling place'.

Terms: विभक्ति-1

etc. have also the sense of 'this is his portion, price or pay'.

Terms: ख
